'''Humbleetle''' is a [[Rock]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Humbug]] at 6 bronze stars, and evolves into [[Zenscarab]] at 18 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "Ask Humbleetle why that dark, gooey stuff is worth eating, and get ready for an earnest breakdown of age, origin, and fermentation process. Most Tatari last for a couple minutes before their stomachs start to hurl."

Humbleetle is a gold rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
TBA

== Evolution Trial ==
Humbleetle's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 18 stars. To evolve it into [[Zenscarab]] you need to complete the following two tasks:

* Feed Humbleetle to increase stats 3 time(s).
* In [[Island Gold Rush]] use Energy Drinks x5,000.

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "Humbleetle loves that orb! It's a comfy scooter, a shiny necklace, a shield, and a secret snack, all in one!"
* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "Trades collections with passing Tatari, often acquiring valuables at little cost."
* Its victory animation of levitating (with its eyes turning red and its arms raised) is a reference to the hit game ''Cult of the Lamb'', with the pose mirroring that of the titular lamb.
